text:
Lina (AE): Heads-up — new enterprise POC asking to drop ISO cert excerpts + signed pen-test letter and a few large log bundles. They prefer SFTP into our staging network or an on‑prem proxy. Need to confirm: can we provide an SFTP endpoint with IP allowlist + 7-day retention? Also need an estimate of any dedicated POC pricing uplift.

Marcus (Solutions): We can support an SFTP proxy but ops likes presigned S3 for auditability. If they insist on SFTP we usually front it with an SFTP->S3 gateway and lock to a single customer bucket and IP allowlist. What size are the bundles?

Lina (AE): Roughly 4–6 GB total, mixed PDFs and zipped logs. Customer will redact PII but wants assurances around ephemeral creds. Timeline: they want access by EOD next Tue.

Priya (Security): For SFTP we need: IP allowlist CIDRs, contact L2 for upload monitoring, and confirmation that files are scanned by our malware pipeline. We also require a redacted pen-test attestation (no tooling details) and a statement of where backups live.

Marcus (Solutions): Ops/eng note: if we do SFTP gateway we'll create a short-lived service account and rotate creds after upload. For presigned links, sample flow: 1) create presigned PUT links per file, 2) set object-lock policy to delete after 7d. Example client curl:

```
curl -X PUT "<presigned-url>" -T artifacts.zip \
  -H "x-amz-acl: private"
```

Ana (RevOps): Cost note — dedicated POC + reserved capacity for heavy ingestion has a baseline uplift. For 1 week of dedicated GPU reservation + network egress and storage lifecycle, estimate +$3.5k — ballpark until I get exact numbers. If we use presigned S3 instead of a managed SFTP gateway there is a ~$300 savings (less infra ops).

Jia (Legal): We'll need the signed pen-test letter and a minimal DPA addendum if customer requests storage in a specific region. Please send the redline requests; I can fast-track the addendum for a short-term POC.

Priya (Security): Quick checklist I can attach in thread: required redaction checklist, allowed file types, max per-file size, and SLA for deletion. Also need proof the customer controls the keys to any redacted artifacts.

Lina (AE): Great — action items: Marcus to confirm whether ops will spin up SFTP gateway or we provide presigned links (target: today). Ana to confirm pricing uplift and provide a quote. Priya to post the redaction checklist and minimum artifact requirements. Jia to prep the DPA addendum template. I'll coordinate with customer and confirm the CIDRs and intended upload date.

deploy-bot: Automated note — staging-bucket/poc-2832101111 created; lifecycle rule set to 7 days retention.

Marcus (Solutions): I'll follow up with ops now. If they want SFTP I'll request a short-lived gateway and provide the upload host + creds by tomorrow morning. Otherwise I'll publish presigned link script and bootstrap the S3 bucket.

Ana (RevOps): Sending a tentative quote in #pricing-drafts, will link here once ready. Expect ~2 hours. :money_with_wings:

Priya (Security): Upload checklist:
- Strip full IP addresses from logs (or mask)
- Remove auth tokens and session IDs
- PDFs: remove embedded metadata
- Allowed formats: .pdf .zip .txt .log
- Max single file: 2GB (if bigger split into parts)
- Provide SHA256 checksums for each file

Lina (AE): Thanks team — will update customer once Marcus/Ana/Jia drop their pieces.

Marcus (Solutions): Update: ops approved presigned links approach; creating bucket policy and IP allowlist. I'll post the presigned-link script soon.

Ana (RevOps): Quote posted: https://redwood-internal/pricing/drafts/2832101111 (public link for internal only).

Jia (Legal): DPA addendum draft uploaded to the drive, note in thread when you want me to send it to customer.

Lina (AE): Sending customer a consolidated note now. Thanks all. :pray:
